services.name: Bluefin Tuna Charters
services.desc: Looking to get out in the deep ocean and catch some massive bluefin tuna? During the fall we host tours to do just that. A much longer tour than our other options, we’ll be going out around 50 miles from shore to get to where entire schools of tuna hang out. Put your angler skills to the test - bluefin are very hard to catch. It’s been cited that it takes on average, two and a half hours to land a single tuna. They are quite smart, and are picky with hook size and bait quality. As such, we advise this trip only to those advanced anglers who are ready to take on a challenge. blurb: Guests can enjoy fishing trips for all experience levels, including inshore fishing in Casco Bay, trips targeting larger game like sea bass, cod, and pollock, and big game bluefin tuna charters in the fall. Scenic cruises are also offered to see forts, lighthouses, and the Portland cityscape, including sunset cruises. The vessel is a 37ft Duffy Downeast style boat with air conditioning and a bathroom.
